[D] Controller edits / agent access
|
|-- UI -> MappingDocumentController
|   |-- applyUpdate(...)                 semantic operation batches
|   |-- commitDocument(...)              document/layout edits
|   |-- updateCanvas(...) / select(...)   pane, control and selection state
|   `-- undo / redo / reset               CanvasHistoryService navigation
|
|-- Agent -> MCP -> HTTP backend
|   `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService.exec()
|       |-- synchronous QuickJS canvas / nodes / edges calls
|       `-- each mutating API call
|           |-- live: CanvasSessionBridge -> browser poll/reply
|           |-- proposal: ChangeSessionService.apply()
|           |-- applyUpdate(currentVersion, [operation])
|           `-- commit its own checkpoint and version
|               `-- later calls see edits; script failure keeps earlier commits
|
`-- MappingDocumentController.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
    |-- check version; clone staged document + canvas
    |-- diagram edits
    |   |-- create -> DiagramService.create()
    |   |-- prepareDiagramEdit -> DiagramService.revise(baseRevisionId, edit)
    |   `-- trackNodes(...) composes exact correspondence
    |-- apply instance / edge / section / view changes
    |-- reanchor untouched patch nodes; edited anchors stale
    |-- run grid layout and validation
    `-- updateSnapshot(..., record = true)
        |-- reconcile connections; normalize diagram views
        |-- resolveFloatingGeometry(...)
        |-- historyService.append(context, document, canvas, correspondence)
        `-- expose checkpoint/version; notify subscribers

transact() retains the controller operation-batch adapter.
An exec script is not one atomic controller batch.
Ordinary measurements / controls add no history/version.
Live edits need a page; proposal edits use backend copies.
Source: mappingDocumentController.ts; sessionService.ts
